about.en: STAMP is the token of Zcash Shielded Assets, a Solana project whose holders burn STAMP to record the burned amount as an inscription on Zcash, to be redeemable for shielded assets if and when that functionality activates. The token is an SPL token minted at EKtmPPLaCbEEKiwoHHtV7TsRsmPXs5CMGtQtZFSiinsc and is not issued by the Zcash project.
